reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000027 (the melody read from 000027a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. John Antes has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1790, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). John Bernard Wilkes's dates are uncertain, so the page says only that they lived in the 19th century; they died by 1928 (https://hymnary.org/person/Wilkes_John (John B. Wilkes, 1785-1869); https://www.praise.org.uk/?p=29310 (the Baptist Hymn Book Companion gives the arranger of MONKLAND a death in 1882; the Historical Companion to Hymns A&M is unsure he was the John Bernard Wilkes born at Leominster in 1823, organist of Llandaff 1861-65). Whichever he was, he arranged MONKLAND in 1861 and died by 1928: the latest candidate was born in 1823, and the pre-1850 rule's 105 years puts his death before 1929.). CCEH's page gives only the year 1861. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000027a.nwc).
